component.name: Nebulous
component.summary: Local-first 4-tier project, bug, and AI agent workflow tracker

description.p: Nebulous is a local-first, Git-backed, 4-tier project and bug tracker built in Rust for Linux developers, rolling-release OS engineering (such as NovOS), and AI-assisted coding workflows.

It pairs a fast companion CLI (neb) and JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol server (neb mcp) with a native libcosmic desktop GUI (nebulous), storing all project state in human-readable TOML manifests and Markdown files inside .tracker/.

ul.li: 4-Tier .tracker/ TOML + Markdown hierarchy with instant index-only startup
Global multi-project registry and two-stage directory ingestion with nebulous.component.toml manifests
Rolling-release dependency pinning and self-healing CI rollback support
Policy-validated self-documenting Git commits, SSH & HTTPS PAT vault (OS keyring + AES-256-GCM fallback)
Built-in Model Context Protocol (neb mcp) server for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Ollama, and CI agents

description.p: Initial release featuring the 4-tier .tracker/ engine, multi-project registry, directory ingestion, Git commit policy, MCP server, and native COSMIC desktop interface.
